summary: Neerlerit Inaat Airport (CNP) serves the remote settlement of Ittoqqortoormiit in eastern Greenland, located on the coast of Scoresby Sund, the world's largest fjord system. The airport is a critical lifeline for the isolated community of roughly 450 residents, providing the only year-round fixed-wing connection to the outside world aside from seasonal sea routes. Ittoqqortoormiit itself was founded in 1925 by Inuit settlers from Tasiilaq, making the airport's role in sustaining one of Greenland's most isolated communities all the more vital.
faqs:
Q: What airlines fly to Neerlerit Inaat Airport?
A: Air Greenland operates scheduled flights primarily to and from Reykjavik, as well as occasional connections to other Greenlandic airports such as Constable Point and Tasiilaq. Charter flights can also be arranged.

Q: How long is the flight from Reykjavik to Neerlerit Inaat?
A: The flight from Reykjavik typically takes around 2 hours, depending on weather and routing through Greenland's airspace.

Q: Is the airport open year-round?
A: Yes, Neerlerit Inaat operates year-round, though flights can be delayed or cancelled due to harsh Arctic weather including fog, snow, and strong winds.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The terminal is small with basic amenities, reflecting the low passenger volume; services are limited but adequate for the community's needs, including handling medical evacuations.
transport_tips: Ground transport in Ittoqqortoormiit is minimal—most visitors are met on arrival or walk short distances to guesthouses. There are no taxis or public buses; arranging pickup in advance with a local host or through your accommodation is strongly recommended. Be prepared to wait outdoors in cold weather, as the terminal building is small and connections can take time.
local_tip: Plan buffer days into your travel itinerary on both ends of your trip—weather-related flight cancellations are common in this part of Greenland and can leave you stranded for 24–72 hours. Bring all essential medications and extra clothing layers, as resupply in Ittoqqortoormiit is limited and delays can be lengthy.
